test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states is the least populated according to census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the 2011 census, Arunachal Pradesh is the least populated state in India. 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is a mountainous state located in the northeastern part of India, bordering China, Myanmar, and Bhutan.
 
• Its rugged terrain and remote location have hindered population growth and development.
 
• Much of Arunachal Pradesh is covered by dense forests and mountainous regions, which are not suitable for large-scale settlement.
 
• This has led to a low population density in many parts of the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The population density is defined as the number of persons per sq km. 
 
• It is one of the important indices of population concentration.
 
• The population density of India in 2011 was 382 per sq km.
 
• Population Density of India's state as per census 2011:-

 
• NCT of Delhi - 11320.
 
• Chandigarh - 9258.
 
• Puducherry -2547.

 
• **Odisha:** Odisha is a relatively large state with a significant population.
 
• **Kerala:** Kerala is known for its high population density and literacy rate.
 
• **Andhra Pradesh:** Andhra Pradesh is another large state with a substantial population.
